text: Keep Budget Plans safe across LEDGER Spend Category rename, archive, reactivation, and reparent. Evidence [analogous]: LEDGER G3 and UC-LEDGER-008 preserve stable category identity and block new use of archived categories. Reparent is in scope because DD-BUDGET-CATEGORY-ENVELOPE-RESOLUTION resolves each Budget Actual through its frozen Spend Category ancestry, so moving a Spend Category changes which Category Budget Entry governs its spend in a later cited snapshot. Actor/workflow trace: P1 through UC-BUDGET-001, UC-BUDGET-002, and UC-BUDGET-004. Requirement trace: FR-BUDGET-CATEGORY-LIFECYCLE, FR-BUDGET-PLAN-DRAFT, FR-BUDGET-PLAN-ACTIVATION, and FR-BUDGET-PLAN-HISTORY.
target: Stable category identity survives rename; historical revisions remain readable after archive; new or revised entries cannot target an inactive category; reactivation never silently revives an omitted or retired amount.
